MERGE INTO REP_PROD_BONUS_REGISTER RPI USING (
SELECT '${item.id}' ID, '${item.prodId}' PROD_ID, #{item.bonusRegisterDate,jdbcType=DATE}null BONUS_REGISTER_DATE, #{item.bonusDealtDate,jdbcType=DATE}null BONUS_DEALT_DATE, ${item.unitBonusAmt}null UNIT_BONUS_AMT, '${item.inputType}' INPUT_TYPE, '${item.inputUser}' INPUT_USER, '${item.adapterId}' ADAPTER_ID, '${item.createUser}' CREATE_USER, '${item.createDept}' CREATE_DEPT, #{item.createTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}null CREATE_TIME, '${item.updateUser}' UPDATE_USER, #{item.updateTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}null UPDATE_TIME FROM sysibm.SYSDUMMY1
) TEMP
ON( RPI.PROD_ID = TEMP.PROD_ID AND RPI.BONUS_REGISTER_DATE = TEMP.BONUS_REGISTER_DATE )
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET RPI.ID = TEMP.ID, RPI.BONUS_DEALT_DATE = TEMP.BONUS_DEALT_DATE, RPI.UNIT_BONUS_AMT = TEMP.UNIT_BONUS_AMT, RPI.INPUT_TYPE = TEMP.INPUT_TYPE, RPI.INPUT_USER = TEMP.INPUT_USER, RPI.ADAPTER_ID = TEMP.ADAPTER_ID, RPI.CREATE_USER = TEMP.CREATE_USER, RPI.CREATE_DEPT = TEMP.CREATE_DEPT, RPI.CREATE_TIME = TEMP.CREATE_TIME, RPI.UPDATE_USER = TEMP.UPDATE_USER, RPI.UPDATE_TIME = TEMP.UPDATE_TIME
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( ID, PROD_ID, BONUS_REGISTER_DATE, BONUS_DEALT_DATE, UNIT_BONUS_AMT, INPUT_TYPE, INPUT_USER, ADAPTER_ID, CREATE_USER, CREATE_DEPT, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME ) VALUES ( TEMP.ID, TEMP.PROD_ID, TEMP.BONUS_REGISTER_DATE, TEMP.BONUS_DEALT_DATE, TEMP.UNIT_BONUS_AMT, TEMP.INPUT_TYPE, TEMP.INPUT_USER, TEMP.ADAPTER_ID, TEMP.CREATE_USER, TEMP.CREATE_DEPT, TEMP.CREATE_TIME, TEMP.UPDATE_USER, TEMP.UPDATE_TIME )
